title: How to Run SteamOS on Your Mac
summary: A free app lets you boot SteamOS in a virtual machine on your Apple Silicon Mac, unlocking PC and legacy games that otherwise won’t run.
llm_summary: A new free app lets Apple‑silicon Mac owners run SteamOS inside a virtual machine, effectively turning their Macs into Linux‑based gaming rigs. By booting SteamOS, you can access a huge library of PC and legacy titles that normally won’t run on macOS, all without needing a separate PC. The setup is straightforward and provides a low‑cost way to expand your gaming options on a Mac.
